_meta.note: Season prices locked at draft open. generate-fantasy-config.js reads this file and emits these prices verbatim; shows announced later are appended here with addedAt. Never remove a show: players may have drafted it.

notes.wanted-2022: Tier 3: New musical (formerly Gun & Powder, whose Signature and Paper Mill runs scored 83 and 86) with Solea Pfeiffer and Ledisi; Gold Derby calls it the homegrown show that could challenge Paddington. Open run. · projected ~$830K/week · 34 scoring weeks of grosses

notes.dolly-an-original-musical-2026: Tier 4: Dolly Parton's autobiographical musical, directed by Bartlett Sher; the Nashville tryout scored 83 and Parton will sell the St. James. Awards upside is capped by the bio-jukebox format. · projected ~$1245K/week · 26 scoring weeks of grosses
notes.school-girls-or-the-african-mean-girls-p: Tier 3: MTC's revival of Jocelyn Bioh's comedy opened Sept 28 to strong reviews (82); Denée Benton and Patina Miller are the acting-nom hopes, but the run ends Nov 1 so almost no grosses are left. · CriticScore already public: no critic points · AudienceGrade already public: no audience points
notes.inter-alia-2026: Tier 4: Rosamund Pike's Olivier-winning Broadway debut in Suzie Miller's follow-up to Prima Facie; the National Theatre run scored 83 with raves for the performance and doubts about the script. Closes Feb 21. · projected ~$546K/week · 14 scoring weeks of grosses
notes.celebrity-autobiography-2026: Tier 1: Five-week return engagement at the Shubert that closed in June with mixed reviews (68); a pure awards long shot. · CriticScore already public: no critic points · AudienceGrade already public: no audience points
notes.paranormal-activity-2026: Tier 2: Opened Aug 25 to Recommended-range reviews (78) and sells out the August Wilson; its awards path is the design categories (sound, lighting, scenic), not Best Play. Closes Jan 3. · CriticScore already public: no critic points · AudienceGrade already public: no audience points

notes.evita-2026: Tier 5: Rachel Zegler's Olivier-winning turn in Jamie Lloyd's Palladium production (scored 82 in London) transfers to the Winter Garden; the consensus Best Revival of a Musical frontrunner. · projected ~$1740K/week · 15 scoring weeks of grosses

notes.gloria-2026: Tier 3: Branden Jacobs-Jenkins's Pulitzer-finalist office thriller at the Hayes, directed by Evan Cabnet; no cast announced yet. · projected ~$681K/week · 12 scoring weeks of grosses (assumed limited run)
